title: Kumamoto earthquake leaves dozens dead, 9,200 evacuated and widespread damage
summary: The quake has caused water outages, damage to homes, factories and the bullet train, and authorities warn of heat and the risk of poisoning in shelters.

title: Yen strengthens to 157 per dollar amid possible official intervention
summary: Japan and the U.S. may have acted in the foreign exchange market to curb the depreciation, although analysts see limited effect if the Bank of Japan does not raise rates.

title: Trump announces plan for Hamas disarmament and second phase of peace in Gaza
summary: The road map presented by his administration links Israel's withdrawal to the group's disarmament and seeks to restart negotiations.

title: United States resumes bombing against Iran and Tehran promises retaliation
summary: Tensions rise with possible attacks this weekend and an increase in crude oil due to fear of disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Explosion in apartment building in Ichikawa leaves two injured and damage in surrounding areas
summary: The blast, which did not cause a fire, took those affected to the hospital and damaged nearby structures, while the cause is being investigated.

title: Humanitarian aid continues in Kumamoto with prime minister's visit and shipment of resources
summary: Regions such as Fukuoka and Noto are sending supplies and mobile toilets, while baseball player Munetaka Murakami organizes a charity auction for those affected.

title: Japan considers reducing consumption tax on food to 1% for two years
summary: The prime minister's initiative creates division in the ruling party over the fiscal cost and doubts about its financing.

title: Thousands of Moroccan migrants enter Spanish enclaves, leaving more than 50 dead
summary: The migratory crisis in Ceuta and Melilla overwhelms services and leads Italy to temporarily suspend free movement with Spain.

title: FIFA withdraws its plan to create a commercial subsidiary for the World Cup after rejection by confederations
summary: The opposition of European and Asian federations, and the resignation of an adviser, led the organization to back down on the project.

title: Intensity 4 earthquake shakes Hokkaido, Aomori and Iwate with no tsunami alert
summary: The tremor was recorded at noon in northern Japan and there was no tsunami risk.

title: Kumamoto's Ozu High School football team finishes third in the Inter-High
summary: The team, which failed in its attempt to reach the final, dedicated the tournament to those affected by the earthquake in their homeland.

title: Trump clarifies there is still no agreement to produce Patriot missiles in Ukraine
summary: The U.S. president clarified that he has not given his consent to the manufacture of interceptor systems on Ukrainian territory.

title: Dow Jones rises 276 points in New York, driven by corporate earnings
summary: The New York stock market closes higher, although the Nasdaq posts two months of declines despite also gaining ground this session.
